messages.content: Extract subject destination presence only. Do not judge story validity. Return JSON only.

DESTINATION
bunker

NAMED SUBJECT
Noor

CANDIDATE BEAT
Noor starts in the bunker and walks to the hallway.

Classify only whether CANDIDATE BEAT establishes that NAMED SUBJECT is physically at/inside DESTINATION at any point during the beat. Allowed values: AT_DESTINATION, NOT_AT_DESTINATION, UNSPECIFIED. AT_DESTINATION includes entering, standing in, acting in, or explicitly being inside DESTINATION even if the subject later leaves. NOT_AT_DESTINATION means the beat explicitly keeps the subject outside/elsewhere and does not place the subject inside. Reaching through an opening while the subject's body remains outside is NOT_AT_DESTINATION. UNSPECIFIED means the subject's relation to DESTINATION is not established clearly enough. Do not decide whether the placement is allowed. Return JSON: {"relation":"..."}

Then she walks to hallway (outside). But relation during beat includes being physically inside bunker initially. So AT_DESTINATION. Return JSON {"relation":"AT_DESTINATION"}.
